threat_event: Attacker exploits a vulnerability in fielded PM-2 monitors to change alarm limits or stop monitoring
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hacktivist on a hospital network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CVD process; no regular patch cycle; threat model not updated since clearance
existing_controls: Signed firmware with secure boot; mutual TLS to the device cloud; hospital network controls
treatment_plan: Publish CVD policy; define quarterly patch cycle plus out-of-cycle procedure; update threat model; annual independent device penetration test

threat_event: Code-signing private key is stolen from the build server and used to sign malicious PM-2 firmware distributed through the update service
threat_source: Advanced or criminal attacker targeting the software supply chain
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signing key stored as a file on the build server; no HSM; six administrators; no second approval for signing
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 build server; SYS-01 update service; SYS-11 PM-2 fleet
existing_controls: Key file is password protected; build server on the engineering VLAN; MFA on the repository
treatment_plan: Move signing keys into an HSM or cloud key management service with non-exportable keys; two-person signing approval; rotate the key and ship the new trust anchor in the next release

threat_event: Security researcher's vulnerability report is lost or ignored and the vulnerability is disclosed publicly before a fix
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No published disclosure policy; security@ mailbox checked ad hoc; no intake time commitment
existing_controls: Mailbox exists on the website
treatment_plan: Publish CVD policy with 3-business-day acknowledgment; ticket queue with alerting; join a health sector ISAO

threat_event: Known exploited vulnerability in a third-party component of the PM-2 firmware goes unnoticed and is exploited in the field
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SBOM manual and out of date; no monitoring against vulnerability sources or the CISA KEV catalog
existing_controls: Component list from 2024 submission
treatment_plan: Generate machine-readable SBOMs in every build; daily matching against vulnerability databases and the KEV catalog

threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the office network into Line 2 MES and test stations and stops production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Line 2 network flat with the office; shared operator logins; no MFA on MES stations
existing_controls: EDR on office endpoints; Lines 1 and 3 segmented
treatment_plan: Segment Line 2 behind the OT firewall; named operator accounts with badge-plus-PIN login; offline backups of MES configuration

threat_event: Intrusion or ransomware in the device cloud interrupts remote viewing and secondary alarm notifications at hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Standing production access; logs not reviewed; no restore test
existing_controls: MFA on the cloud console; monthly scans; primary alarms sound at the bedside
treatment_plan: Centralized log review with alerting; just-in-time production access; restore test

threat_event: Flaw in tenant separation lets one hospital's users see another hospital's patients
threat_source: Software defect exploited by a user or attacker
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenant checks in application code; no independent penetration test of the device cloud
existing_controls: Tenant ID enforced in application and database row-level security; code review
treatment_plan: Independent penetration test with cross-tenant test cases; automated tenant-isolation tests in CI

threat_event: Compromised or misused support account exfiltrates PHI across all hospital tenants
threat_source: Insider or attacker using stolen credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 engineers with standing access to all tenants; no access review; logs not reviewed
existing_controls: MFA; role-based console access
treatment_plan: Just-in-time, ticket-approved production access; quarterly access reviews; alert on bulk queries

threat_event: PHI in application logs is exposed by the log analytics vendor that has no BAA
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No subcontractor BAA; logs include patient names and MRNs
existing_controls: Vendor has a SOC 2 report; TLS to vendor
treatment_plan: Mask patient identifiers in logs before export; sign subcontractor BAA or replace vendor

threat_event: FDA refuses to accept or delays the AI-001 submission, or issues an observation, because 524B elements are missing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No CVD procedure; SBOM incomplete; no patch cycle; management plan not operated
existing_controls: PM-2 submission included cybersecurity documentation
treatment_plan: Close the P03 524B roadmap before the 2027 Q3 submission; pre-submission meeting with FDA

threat_event: Hospital customers delay renewals because the device cloud has only a SOC 2 Type 1 report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Type 1 covers design at a point in time, Security only
existing_controls: SOC 2 Type 1 (2026-03-31); readiness plan (P09)
treatment_plan: Start Type 2 observation period 2027-01-01 covering Security, Availability, Confidentiality

threat_event: Attacker with a stolen developer credential inserts malicious code into device firmware
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Branch protection allows self-approval for release branches
existing_controls: MFA on the repository; code review on main branch
treatment_plan: Require two reviewers and signed commits on release branches; build provenance records

threat_event: Compromised open-source dependency enters the cloud or firmware build
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No dependency pinning policy for firmware builds
existing_controls: Container and dependency scanning for cloud code
treatment_plan: Pin and verify hashes for firmware dependencies; internal package mirror

threat_event: Per-hospital shared API key extracted from one PM-1 unit lets an attacker spoof telemetry or query that hospital's data
threat_source: Attacker with physical access to a PM-1
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PM-1 uses a shared key per hospital; no per-device identity
existing_controls: TLS; key limited to write-only telemetry and read of own device settings
treatment_plan: Rotate keys per hospital; restrict API scope; migrate PM-1 customers to PM-2 before June 2027

threat_event: PM-1 embedded operating system component reaches end of support with no further security fixes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: End of support June 2027; PM-1 supported to 2028
regulatory_driver: FDA postmarket guidance (2016); N31-33-R05 (524B(b)(2)(A) for future submissions)
existing_controls: Supplier notice received
treatment_plan: Customer end-of-support notice; trade-in program; compensating network controls guide

threat_event: Cloud provider regional outage lasts longer than the device cloud RTO
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single active region; failover never tested
existing_controls: Backups copied to a second region
treatment_plan: Documented regional recovery runbook; annual failover exercise

threat_event: Device cloud database cannot be restored after corruption or deletion
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups never restore-tested; backup administration not separated
existing_controls: Daily backups with point-in-time recovery; second-region copy
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests; immutable backup retention in a separate account

threat_event: Hospitals are notified late of a PHI breach in the device cloud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No business associate breach procedure; BAA notice terms not tracked
existing_controls: BAAs signed
treatment_plan: Product security incident procedure with BA notice steps and a BAA terms register (P08)

threat_event: Operator using a shared MES login changes test limits and nonconforming monitors are released
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator logins; no change log on test limits
existing_controls: Supervisor sign-off on each lot; final QA sampling
treatment_plan: Named operator accounts; test-limit changes under change control

threat_event: Test station programs an unauthorized firmware image onto monitors during production
threat_source: Insider or malware on a test station
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Test stations on Line 2 reachable from the office network
existing_controls: PM-2 secure boot rejects unsigned images; final test verifies firmware hash
treatment_plan: Segment Line 2 (R-005); whitelist approved image hashes on test stations

threat_event: Phishing compromises an engineering laptop and design files are stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High phishing volume; design data in several systems
existing_controls: MFA; EDR; annual training
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing simulations; data loss alerts for bulk PLM exports

threat_event: Former employee keeps access to the repository or PLM
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Some engineering tools use local accounts outside SSO
existing_controls: Same-day disable in the identity provider
treatment_plan: Move remaining local accounts to SSO; quarterly reconciliation

threat_event: Hurricane closes the Florida facility for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single facility for production, engineering, and support
existing_controls: Device cloud hosted outside Florida; laptops for remote work
treatment_plan: Business continuity plan with remote support, finished-goods buffer, and alternate shipping

threat_event: A cybersecurity-related malfunction is not evaluated for MDR or correction reporting and FDA reports are late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Complaint and MDR procedures do not address cybersecurity signals
existing_controls: General complaint and MDR procedures
treatment_plan: Add cybersecurity decision points to complaint, MDR, and 806 procedures; train complaint handlers

threat_event: Code-signing key is lost to a disk failure and no firmware fix can be signed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single copy of the key; no escrow
existing_controls: Server disk mirroring
treatment_plan: Covered by HSM migration with backup key shares held by two officers (R-002)

threat_event: Denial of service against the device ingestion endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing endpoint
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; monitors buffer 72 hours locally
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; monitors keep data locally and resend

threat_event: AI-001 skin-image model misses pressure injuries more often for patients with darker skin
threat_source: AI model error and dataset bias
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training images skewed toward lighter skin tones; no bias testing plan
regulatory_driver: N31-33-R05 (524B for the planned submission); FDA AI guidance (draft, January 2025)
existing_controls: Clinician review of every flag planned
treatment_plan: Bias testing plan by skin tone group before design freeze (P10)

threat_event: Engineers paste proprietary source code into public generative AI assistants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved AI tools list; no guidance
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Approved enterprise coding assistant with no-training terms; POL-05 rule; block public tools on engineering laptops

threat_event: Compromised PM-2 is used as a pivot into a hospital network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Maintenance interface listens on the hospital network
existing_controls: Device firewall allows only listed ports; customer security guide
treatment_plan: Disable the maintenance interface by default in the next release; update the ports list in the security guide

threat_event: Stolen laptop exposes design files or support data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops travel to hospitals
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the IT Manager: residual risk Low

threat_event: Complaint, MDR, correction, and vulnerability records are not retained long enough to support FDA inspection or HIPAA documentation duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vulnerability and CVD records kept in email only
existing_controls: eQMS retains complaint and MDR records
treatment_plan: Keep CVD and PSIRT records in the eQMS; security documentation kept 6 years

threat_event: Attacker uses the PM-2 service password, which is the same on every unit, to reach the maintenance interface and change settings
threat_source: Cybercriminal or insider with the service manual
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One service password across all PM-2 units, printed in the service manual (found in P07 testing)
existing_controls: Interface reachable only from the hospital network
treatment_plan: Out-of-cycle firmware with unique per-device service credentials; customer advisory with compensating controls within 30 days
